title: fisk-ai session store v1 deferred call record

tool_use_id.description: The tool_use id whose answer arrives later. A tool_result record carrying the same id later answers it; until one does, the call is never re-run.

tool_name.description: The tool that deferred, as it was dispatched.

note.description: What the call is waiting on, in the tool's own words. Display text: sanitize before rendering.

handle.description: The tool's own identifier for the outstanding work. Never interpreted here.

kind.description: The provider that took the call: application, builtin, remote, custom, mcp or unknown. Copied onto the tool_result record that answers it, since whoever supplies the answer does not know it. Additive and optional; a record written before it existed answers under the unknown kind.

dispatched.description: Set when the call reached its provider, absent when a prompter deferred it before it ran. Copied onto the answering tool_result record, where it separates the calls that were made from the calls that were asked for.
